_publications._publicationTitle: Traditional and systems biology based drug discovery for the rare tumor syndrome neurofibromatosis type 2
_publications._context: Human fetal Schwann cell line with NF2 suppressed via shRNA, retaining ~3% merlin protein expression. Paired with the wildtype control HS11 in the Synodos NF2 consortium panel.

basicInfo.description: Human fetal Schwann cell line with stable shRNA knockdown of NF2 (~3% residual merlin protein); paired control is HS11.
